Class JsonWriter

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonWriter
public final class JsonWriter extends Object

Writes values as JSON, in UTF-8: compact, the default, or pretty, indented with 2 spaces.

String compact = new JsonWriter().format(value);  // {"id":42,"tags":["a"]}
String pretty = JsonWriter.pretty().format(value);

Strings escape ", \ and the control characters, and are written in UTF-8 otherwise; one with an unpaired surrogate, which UTF-8 cannot encode, is an IllegalArgumentException. Numbers are written as they were parsed or created.

A writer is immutable and thread-safe, and holds nothing but its settings: creating one per call costs nothing.

Since:
0.1.0
